{{Short description|Asian semiconductor equipment manufacturer}} {{Use dmy dates|date=March 2024}} {{Infobox company | name = ASMPT Limited | native_name = | logo = Asmpt logo 2022.svg | former_name = ASM Pacific Technology Limited | type = [[Public company|Public]] | traded_as = {{SEHK|522}} | founded = {{start date and age|1975}} | hq_location = Singapore | founders = Arthur del Prado
Patrick Lam | key_people = Orasa Livasiri (Chairman)
Robin Ng (CEO) | revenue = {{Decrease}} {{HKD|link=yes|14.70 billion}} (2023) | net_income = {{Decrease}} {{HKD|link=yes|711.50 million}} (2023) | assets = {{Decrease}} {{HKD|link=yes|23.96 billion}} (2023) | equity = {{Decrease}} {{HKD|link=yes|15.80 billion}} (2023) | owner = [[ASM International]] (25%) | num_employees = 11,300 (2022) | industry = [[Semiconductors]] | subsidiaries = [[Critical Manufacturing]] | website = {{URL|www.asmpt.com}} | footnotes = {{cite web |title=2023 Annual Report |url=https://www.asmpt.com/site/assets/files/63815/e_00522ar-20240329.pdf |website=ASMPT}} }} '''ASMPT''', formerly known as '''ASM Pacific Technology''', is a [[Singapore]]-headquartered company listed in [[Hong Kong]] that designs and manufactures machines and tools used in [[semiconductor]] and electronics assembly industries. It was originally the Asia division of [[ASM International]] (ASM). == History == In 1975, [[ASM International|ASM]] founder Arthur del Prado went to Hong Kong for a business meeting with its customer [[Philips]]. During his time there, he took the opportunity to survey the prospects for the semiconductor industry in Hong Kong. Eventually he established ASM Pacific Technology (ASMPT) with Patrick Lam, an [[Electrical engineering|electrical engineer]] that del Prado recruited during his visit.{{Cite web |last=Tang |first=Hung Kei |date=2001 |title=ASM Pacific Technology Limited |url=https://dr.ntu.edu.sg/handle/10356/100498 |publisher=Asian Business Case Centre |language=en |access-date=16 March 2024 |archive-date=16 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240316081503/https://dr.ntu.edu.sg/handle/10356/100498 |url-status=live }}{{Cite web |date=9 August 2013 |title=ASMPT enables developers with full-spectrum and accurate solutions |url=https://www.scmp.com/article/1295525/asmpt-enables-developers-full-spectrum-and-accurate-solutions |access-date=16 March 2024 |website=South China Morning Post |language=en |archive-date=17 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211017211451/https://www.scmp.com/article/1295525/asmpt-enables-developers-full-spectrum-and-accurate-solutions |url-status=live }} At first, the company’s business was acting as an agent for the sales of semiconductor materials and shelf production in Asia.{{Cite web |title=ASM太平洋創辦人林師龐：科技靠人和！ - 信報財經月刊 hkej.com |url=https://monthly.hkej.com/monthly/article/id/2199616/ASM%E5%A4%AA%E5%B9%B3%E6%B4%8B%E5%89%B5%E8%BE%A6%E4%BA%BA%E6%9E%97%E5%B8%AB%E9%BE%90%EF%BC%9A%E7%A7%91%E6%8A%80%E9%9D%A0%E4%BA%BA%E5%92%8C%EF%BC%81 |access-date=16 March 2024 |website=信報財經月刊 |archive-date=5 August 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220805165851/https://monthly.hkej.com/monthly/article/id/2199616/ASM%E5%A4%AA%E5%B9%B3%E6%B4%8B%E5%89%B5%E8%BE%A6%E4%BA%BA%E6%9E%97%E5%B8%AB%E9%BE%90%EF%BC%9A%E7%A7%91%E6%8A%80%E9%9D%A0%E4%BA%BA%E5%92%8C%EF%BC%81 |url-status=live }} Originally ASMPT was an Asian sales branch of ASM which derived its revenue from the sale of encapsulation equipment from the [[Netherlands]] and related materials from the U.S. By 1977, ASMPT had established a sizeable customer base and moved into small-scale production of mold bases. Soon it was producing custom-designed trim and form tools. In 1979, ASMPT made two landmark decisions. The first was to acquire a 10,000 square-foot industrial property to support its move into the production of [[lead frame]]s. The second was the acquisition of a [[wire bonder]] manufacturing business in Hong Kong from an American company. In 1980, ASMPT looked into designing its own automated equipment. To do this, the company went on an aggressive recruitment spree to attract young engineering university graduates. In 1981, it launched a conversion kit that enabled manual aluminum wire bonder to operate semi-automatically. By 1984, it launched its fully-automatic wire bonders. In 1985, ASMPT produced its first die bonder aimed at LED manufacturers. By the end of the 1980s, the sales of leadframes and equipment provided steady profit streams for ASMPT. At the end of 1989, ASMPT opened a plant in [[Shenzhen]]. ASMPT shifted its attention from manufacturing to [[research and development]] (R&D). Singapore was selected as its new R&D location due to tax incentives from the [[Economic Development Board]]. Former ASMPT CEO, Lee Wai-kwong stated that Hong Kong engineers would find a solution in the shortest possible time and be done with it while Singapore engineers would take longer to understand the root cause and come up with a more effective solution. ASMPT's growth was financed mainly through [[retained earnings]] and bank loans. To expand further, ASMPT chose to become a [[public company]] to acquire additional funding. In January 1989, ASMPT held its [[initial public offering]] by listing on the [[Hong Kong Stock Exchange]] with del Prado as chairman and Lam as managing director. In 2011, ASMPT acquired the electronics assembly systems business of [[Siemens]].{{Cite web |last=Alpern |first=Peter |date=29 July 2010 |title=Siemens Unloads Electronics Assembly Systems Unit to ASM Pacific |url=https://www.industryweek.com/innovation/article/21935816/siemens-unloads-electronics-assembly-systems-unit-to-asm-pacific |access-date=16 March 2024 |website=IndustryWeek |archive-date=16 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240316081504/https://www.industryweek.com/innovation/article/21935816/siemens-unloads-electronics-assembly-systems-unit-to-asm-pacific |url-status=live }} In 2014, ASMPT acquired DEK Printing Machines Ltd from the [[Dover Corporation]].{{Cite web |title=ASMPT completes DEK acquisition |url=https://siliconsemiconductor.net/article/94350/ASMPT_completes_DEK_acquisition |access-date=2025-06-03 |website=siliconsemiconductor.net}} ASMPT acquired AMICRA Microtechnologies GmbH in April 2018.{{Cite web |title=ASM Pacific Technology Acquires Amicra to Enter the Photonics Market |url=https://www.acnnewswire.com/press-release/english/42601/asm-pacific-technology-acquires-amicra-to-enter-the-photonics-market |access-date=2024-08-01 |website=www.acnnewswire.com}} In August 2018, ASMPT acquired [[Critical Manufacturing]].{{Cite web |title=ASM Assembly Singapore acquired Portuguese Critical Manufacturing |url=https://www.thecfigroup.com/transactions/asm-assembly-singapore-acquired-portuguese-critical-manufacturing/ |access-date=2024-03-16 |website=The CFI Group |language=en-US |archive-date=11 August 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220811184726/https://www.thecfigroup.com/transactions/asm-assembly-singapore-acquired-portuguese-critical-manufacturing/ |url-status=live }} ASM has reduced its stake in ASMPT over the years. In 1997, 51% of ASMPT was owned by ASM. In 2013, it sold 11.9% of ASMPT making it no longer a [[majority shareholder]].{{Cite news |last=Noordhuis |first=Maaike |date=14 March 2013 |title=ASMI Cuts ASM Pacific Stake With $550 Million Share Sale |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2013-03-13/asmi-plans-to-reduce-holding-in-asm-pacific-to-as-little-as-40- |access-date=16 March 2024 |work=Bloomberg.com |language=en |archive-date=24 December 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171224165912/https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2013-03-13/asmi-plans-to-reduce-holding-in-asm-pacific-to-as-little-as-40- |url-status=live }} By 2018, ASM's stake in ASMPT was at 25% and [[Elliott Investment Management]] was pushing for ASM to divest from ASMPT. At that time one of the potential buyers was [[TCL Technology]].{{Cite news |last=Baigorri |first=Manuel |date=28 September 2018 |title=TCL Mulls Bid for ASMI's $1 Billion Asian Arm Stake |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-09-28/tcl-is-said-to-mull-bid-for-asmi-s-1-billion-stake-in-asian-arm |access-date=16 March 2024 |work=Bloomberg.com |language=en |archive-date=24 October 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191024080007/https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-09-28/tcl-is-said-to-mull-bid-for-asmi-s-1-billion-stake-in-asian-arm |url-status=live }} In recent times, ASMPT has been exploring going private. It would later relist on the [[Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market]] where it would obtain higher valuations. ASM supported the proposal although it would not divest its stake.{{Cite web |last=Wu |first=Kane |date=22 September 2020 |title=Exclusive: Hong Kong-listed semiconductor maker ASM Pacific plans to go private |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSKCN26D0EW/ |website=Retuers}} In February 2021, ASM and EV Group partnered to develop die-to-wafer bonding techniques for 3d-IC.{{Cite web |title=ASMPT Portfolio Investments, ASMPT Funds, ASMPT Exits |url=https://www.cbinsights.com/investor/asm-pacific-technology |access-date=2024-08-02 |website=www.cbinsights.com}} In August 2022, the company changed its name from ASM Pacific Technology to ASMPT to avoid confusion with ASM International.[https://www.asmpt.com/news/asmpt-marks-latest-milestone-with-global-rebrand/ ASMPT Marks Latest Milestone with Global Rebrand - ASMPT Corporate]{{Dead link|date=July 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}[https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2022/0801/2022080100729.pdf PRESS RELEASE - ASMPT Marks Latest Milestone with Global Rebrand] In March 2023 it was reported that [[PAG (investment firm)|PAG]] was interested in acquiring ASMPT.{{Cite news |date=10 March 2023 |title=Chip Equipment Maker ASMPT Draws Takeover Interest, Sources Say |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-03-10/chip-equipment-maker-asmpt-is-said-to-draw-takeover-interest |access-date=16 March 2024 |work=Bloomberg.com |language=en |archive-date=16 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240316081523/https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-03-10/chip-equipment-maker-asmpt-is-said-to-draw-takeover-interest |url-status=live }} In October 2024, it was reported that [[Kohlberg Kravis Roberts]] was considering acquiring ASMPT.{{Cite news |last=Tse |first=Crystal |date=2024-10-02 |title=KKR Is Said to Weigh Takeover Bid for Chip Gear Maker ASMPT |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-10-02/kkr-is-said-to-weigh-takeover-bid-for-chip-equipment-maker-asmpt |access-date=2024-11-10 |work=Bloomberg.com |language=en}} ==See also== *[[ASM International]] ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * {{Official website|http://www.asmpt.com}} [[Category:1975 establishments in Hong Kong]] [[Category:Companies of Singapore]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Electronics companies established in 1975]] [[Category:Equipment semiconductor companies]] [[Category:Semiconductor companies of Singapore]]
extract: ASMPT, formerly known as ASM Pacific Technology, is a Singapore-headquartered company listed in Hong Kong that designs and manufactures machines and tools used in semiconductor and electronics assembly industries. It was originally the Asia division of ASM International (ASM).
